prompts.text: Your code works only when it's raining.
The submit button sends the form twice.
An emoji appears in the page title after every deploy.
The server returns 200 even when the request failed.
The app crashes if you click fast enough.
A loading spinner that never finishes is now 'art'.
The logout button sits right next to the delete-account button.
The font size changes when you resize the window.
The site works in Internet Explorer — somehow.
Every error message now says 'try turning it off and on again.'
The cursor becomes a 🍕 when you hover the logo.
Your code only fails when the client is watching.
The onboarding flow skips step two entirely.
A confetti burst fires on every successful deploy.
The dark theme is slightly darker on Fridays.
Printing the page also prints the footer twice.
The app auto-saves every keystroke and deletes your undo history.
The API returns results in reverse alphabetical order.
